newsitem.title: USA: Children's Comprehensive Q3 net increases.
newsitem.headline: Children's Comprehensive Q3 net increases.

text.p: Three Months Ended Nine Months Ended
NOTE: Childrens Comprehensive Services Inc said its third period ended March 31.

Net income for the first nine months of fiscal 1997 contain a nonrecurring extraordinary charge of $448,000, or $0.06 per fully diluted share, related to the early retirement of debt, and a nonrecurring credit to income tax expense of $1,783,000, or $0.25 per fully diluted share, related to reversal of a portion of the valuation allowance against the company's deferred tax assets.

Fully taxed net income per fully diluted share for the latest quarter was $0.16, up from $0.13 for the comparable three months in 1996, on a 27.9 percent increase in fully diluted weighted average common shares and equivalents outstanding as a result primarily of the common stock offering in August 1996.
